verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents a GraphQL Developer API with introspection, an API playground, and push APIs, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes API versioning, version identifiers, or a deprecation or sunset policy. Having an API does not show that it is versioned or governed by a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
